question: Do human-work traces on the object (door/hatch/AV open, switched off, de-energised, motion, glass, manual call point) precede fresh connection_loss_gt2s events more often than matched controls?
scope: development evaluation years 2023 and 2024; fresh events only; controls = same object, hour and weekday at +-7/14 days without object events within +-24 h
verdict: no signal passes the pre-declared criterion (ratio >= 2 and coverage >= 10% in both years); traces accompany events (last record ~12-16 min before start) rather than warn; one daily-feature candidate: de-energised pumps/fans on the object in the previous day (ratio 1.76/1.51, share 13.6/21.1% vs 7.8/14.0%)
scripts_note: local scripts and ID-level tables stay outside Git in data-science/artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/ideas/i2/

prereg.written: 2026-09-26, before any signal-vs-control metric was computed (only the text inventory of the journal for 2022-12..2024-12 was looked at to fix exact states)
prereg.idea: I2 from NEXT_IDEAS_2026-09-26.md: traces of human work precede fresh connection_loss_gt2s events on the same object
prereg.status: descriptive check; no model training; development events only, evaluation years 2023 and 2024 separately; 2025-2026 events, labels and journal rows are not read

source.journal: open_fire_source(ROOT): curated journal-curated-v4 + alarm-spike-exclusions-v1 overlay, view working_events; months 2022-11..2024-12; time = TRY_CAST(event_ts_local_raw AS TIMESTAMP) (local wall time, as the v2 labels)
source.events: model_labels_v2/events/connection_loss_gt2s events.parquet + event_members.parquet, split_period='development', qualifies=true, event_start in [Y-01-01, Y+1-01-01), Y in {2023, 2024}

prereg.fresh: event with no earlier qualifying event start on the same object in the same calendar day (d_feasibility fresh_flags); sensitivity: fresh_strict = also no earlier connection_loss episode start (tables/episodes_q24h.parquet, any duration) on the object that day

signals.door_hatch_open: value_raw='Не замкнут' on sensor_type in ('КД Дверь','КД Люк'), any alarm (details door/hatch separately in results)
signals.av_open: value_raw='Не замкнут' on sensor_type='КД АВ', any alarm
signals.switched_off_device: value_raw='Выключен' on any typed channel except operating-mode actuators ('Переключатель','Состояние насоса','Состояние вентилятора')
signals.deenergized: value_raw='Обесточен' on any typed channel (split in results: 'Состояние фазы' vs other types)
signals.motion: value_raw='Обнаружено движение' on sensor_type='Датчик движения', any alarm
signals.glass: value_raw='Не замкнут' on sensor_type='Стекло', any alarm
signals.manual_call_point: value_raw='Не замкнут' on sensor_type='Ручной извещатель', any alarm
signals.any_trace: union of the seven signals above
signals.report_only: 'Выключен' on the operating-mode actuators (pumps/fans/switches) — as used by GAP §2 ('Выключен' on the object), not part of the verdict

prereg.signal_scope: same object_id as the event (any channel of the object, including the event's own member channels); sensitivity: excluding the event's member channels (for controls, the same channel set of the parent event)

windows.W24: [a - 24 h, a - 10 min) (task: '[s0 - 24 h, s0)'; the last 10 min are cut as in W1/W3)
windows.PD: [D - 1 day 00:00, D 00:00), D = local calendar day of a: strictly visible at the daily 00:00 cutoff (added because W24 is partly after 00:00 and thus not visible to the daily model)
windows.anchor: a = s0 (event_start) for events, a = s0 + d days for controls

controls.definition: same object, same local time of day and weekday: a = s0 + d days, d in {-14, -7, +7, +14}
controls.exclusion: no connection_loss_gt2s event start (development, any qualifies) of the object in [a - 24 h, a + 24 h)
controls.admissible: a + 24 h <= 2025-01-01 (so the exclusion window stays in development) and a >= 2022-12-02
controls.note: controls are not restricted to fresh-type moments; they are event-free moments of the same object

prereg.eligibility: anchors (events and controls) with working_covered = true for local day(a) and day(a) - 1 (no policy days exist in 2022-11..2024-12)

analysis_sets.coverage_set: eligible fresh events of the year
analysis_sets.matched_set: eligible fresh events with >= 1 eligible control; control share pooled over their controls
analysis_sets.continuations: reported for context (share with signal among non-fresh events), no verdict

metrics_per_year_signal_window: share of fresh events with the signal (matched set) and share of controls with the signal; ratio = event share / control share; 95% bootstrap CI of the ratio (1000 resamples of events with their controls, seed 17), informative only
coverage = share of eligible fresh events (coverage set) with the signal
median lead = s0 - time of the last signal record in the window (events with the signal); also from the first record
breakdown by working hours (local Mon-Fri, a in [09:00, 13:00)) vs other; controls inherit the stratum (same hour and weekday)
breakdown by event sensor type: dominant member sensor type (most member channels; ties -> phase, smoke, other): 'Состояние фазы' / 'Датчик дыма' / other; controls inherit
product idea: share of fresh events with the signal in W24 and in PD, vs controls
prereg.criterion: a signal is useful for forecasting if, on BOTH 2023 and 2024, in W3 or W1: ratio >= 2 (point estimate, matched set) AND coverage >= 10% of fresh events; otherwise it is unsuitable. Evaluated for the 7 signals and any_trace; multiplicity (8 signals x 2 windows) is disclosed, no correction. Breakdowns, W24/PD, sensitivities do not change the verdict.
prereg.daily_feature_rule: a signal is proposed as a daily-model feature (previous day before the 00:00 cutoff) only if in PD on both years ratio >= 1.5 and fresh-event share >= 10%; otherwise noted as weak
checks: truncation: for 8 cut times T (each equal to a - 10 min of a randomly chosen event, seed 17) the signals are re-extracted from the journal with rows at or after T dropped; every anchor with window end <= T (W1/W3/W24 end = a - 10 min, PD end = D 00:00) gets identical flags and leads
no control anchor has an event start of the object in [a - 24 h, a + 24 h) and no control coincides with an event start
results.json contains no object/channel/event identifiers (no *_id keys, no event_id strings, no object_id values as keys)
prereg.outputs: i2.py, signals.parquet and anchors.parquet (contain IDs, gitignored), results.json and checks.json (aggregates only)

results.multiplicity: 8 verdict signals x 2 windows x 2 years, no correction; breakdowns/W24/PD/sensitivities are descriptive
